name: usage_run_out
label: usage run-out vs reset
why: weekly usage on pace to run out before its reset: the burn forecast (state/burn.json, cost.burn_findings)

name: accept_to_merge
label: accept-to-merge minutes
why: from a brief's accepted_at to its lane_landed event; 30 min is a starting value, provisional until the numbers are seen (T-5709)

name: rework_rounds
label: builder rework rounds
unit: review rounds per landed lane, 14 days
why: per reviewed lane, the distinct lane trees an audit prep was briefed on plus each changes_asked on a tree no prep covers (T-5972: a round sent by message writes no prep); a lane with no prep and no ask is left out of the divisor. A clean lane is one round, so the target is 1.5 (a strict over-target on 1.0 would read every clean lane as rework): an average over 1.5 means builders return with findings a self-review should have caught

name: tokens_per_change
label: tokens per landed change
unit: input-equivalent tokens per landed task, 14 days
why: the per-lane cost reader's tokens (cost.per_lane, T-5973) per landed task, lead and agents, averaged over the lanes with tokens; the cost cache's per-task tokens stand in until it has read; 3,000,000 is a starting value, provisional until the numbers are seen (T-5709)

name: push_lag
label: push lag
unit: h since the oldest trunk commit origin/main lacks
why: git cherry origin/main on the main checkout's trunk: a ship that died before the push leaves commits only this machine has (T-5973)

name: lead_context
label: lead context per turn
unit: cache-read tokens per lead turn, median over 3 days
why: the standing context the lead re-reads on every reply (cost.lead_cache_read's figure): a session that grows past the target is one the user had to compact or restart (T-5973)

name: compactions
label: compactions per session-day
why: the summaries Claude Code writes when a session runs out of context, per session-day (a session's day with a message in it, 7 days; the days of the sessions add up): each one is a hand-off the user had to carry (T-5973)

name: disk_growth
label: Sampo disk growth
unit: MB per day, Sampo's own paths (tidy --report)
why: the change in the bytes tidy --report finds Sampo owns, between the oldest and newest daily sample of 7 days; a flat footprint is the goal, and 0 is a floor every busy day crosses, so it is provisional until the numbers are seen (T-5973)

name: steers
label: steers per day
unit: avoidable steers per day, over the days the meter has read (up to 7)
why: the steer meter's avoidable messages (steers.jsonl; machine text and compaction summaries left out) per calendar day, over the days its rows cover (up to 7, at least 1; unmeasured when its record has stopped for a day): each is a time the user had to say what Sampo could have known (T-5973)

name: sampo_vs_bare
label: Sampo overhead vs bare Claude Code
unit: x plain Claude Code's cost per landed change (bench)
why: Sampo's cost per landed change against plain Claude Code's (the bench's bare arm); 0.5 is an assumption to confirm (T-5709)

name: cpu
label: CPU vs goal
unit: % of the machine's cores, Sampo's sessions over 10 min
why: the CPU goal (cpu.GOAL): the sessions' samples in state/cpu.json over WINDOW_S
